087/**
088 * Provides a way to display a list of elements and map them to corresponding
089 * database keys. These keys are typically provided by {@code setDisplayValues} method;
090 * if param keys are null they default to zero to N-1.
091 * The keys for the selected {@code JList} values are typically in a DB as
092 * controlled by a {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.models.DbCollection};
093 * if not specified {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.models.DbArray} is
094 * used by default and this model saves the selected keys in a column of
095 * type {@code JDBCType.ARRAY}.
096 *
097 * {@snippet class=ListSnippets region=init1}
098 * From the example above, if three values VLarge, medium, small are selected the
099 * array element in the database will store {100.0,5.0,1.0}
100 *
101 * @see KeyDisplayValueSwingModel
102 *
103 * @param <K>
104 * @param <D>
105 */
106// TODO: Fix inconsistent remodel and getChosenItem?
107//       See ComboBox2 for hints. But there's only
108//       a basic model (no locking). Either make
109//       "correct" or make it simplest, like a single
110//       remodel that's never closed.
111@SuppressWarnings("serial")
112public class SsList1<K, D> extends JList<ListItem> implements SsComponent {
113  /**
114   * Listener(s) for the component's value used to propagate changes back to bound
115   * text field.
116   */
117  @SuppressWarnings("serial")
118  protected class ListListener implements ListSelectionListener {
119    /** {@inheritDoc} */
120    @Override
121    public void valueChanged(ListSelectionEvent e) {
122      // While adjusting don't need to update the database.
123      if (e.getValueIsAdjusting())
124        return;
125
126      try {
127        dbChange(() -> updateRowSet());
128      } catch (SQLException ex) {
129        logger.log(Level.ERROR, ex.getMessage(), ex);
130      }
131    }
132  }

179  public SsList1(DbCollection dbCollection) {

181
182    finishSsCommon();
183
184    // Last line of constructor, safe to access this.
185    Model.install(this);
186  }

188  /**
189   * Check metadata to pick an {@link DbCollection}.
190   */
191  @Override
192  public void metadataChange() {
193    if (!collectionSet) {
194      try {
195        // Note: the JDBCType was specified when constructing "this"
196        dbCollection = DbCollection.getSuitableDbCollection(this, dbCollection.getJDBCType());
197      } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
198        logger.log(Level.ERROR, ex.getMessage(), ex);
199        throw ex;
200      } catch (SQLException ex) {
201        logger.log(Level.ERROR, ex.getMessage(), ex);
202        throw new SqlRuntimeException(ex);
203      } finally {
204        collectionSet = true;
205      }
206    }
207  }

335  /**
336   * Sets the displayValues to be displayed in the list based on the enum
337   * class' value's toString(). Generate {@literal [0-N)} keys, which
338   * corresponds to e.ordinal().
339   *
340   * @param <T> inferred enum type
341   * @param enumDisplayValues enum class with values to display
342   */
343  public <T extends Enum<T>> void setDisplayValues(Class<T> enumDisplayValues) {
344    if (getDisplayValueType() != String.class)
345      throw new IllegalArgumentException("DisplayValue type must be String for Enum displayValues");
346
347    List<String> l01 = Stream.of(enumDisplayValues.getEnumConstants())
348                           .map((t) -> t.toString())
349                           .collect(Collectors.toList());
350
351    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
352    List<D> l02 = (List<D>) l01;
353    setDisplayValues(l02, null);
354  }
355
356  /**
357   * Sets the displayValues to be displayed in the list box along with their
358   * corresponding keys to database values. If {@code keys} is null, then zero
359   * to N-1 keys are automatically established.
360   * <p>
361   * If keys is null, then autogenerate the keys; keys type must be Integer or
362   * Long.
363   *
364   * @param displayValues  displayed in the list box.
365   * @param keys null or database values that correspond to the displayValues,
366   *             1 to 1, in the list box.
367   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if lists are not the same size.
368   */
369  public void setDisplayValues(List<D> displayValues, List<K> keys) {
370    setDisplayValuesInternal(displayValues, keys);
371  }
372
373  /**
374   * Set up the specified keys/displayValues.
375   * <p>
376   * If _keys is null, then autogenerate the keys; _keys type must be Integer
377   * or Long.
378   *
379   * @param _displayValues
380   * @param _keys
381   */
382  // TODO: Don't allow Object for autogenerated keys
383  protected void setDisplayValuesInternal(List<D> _displayValues, List<K> _keys) {
384    Objects.requireNonNull(_displayValues);
385    if (_keys == null && getKeyType() != Integer.class && getKeyType() != Long.class
386        && getKeyType() != Object.class)
387      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Auto generated key only avaialable for int/long keys");
388    if (_keys != null && _displayValues.size() != _keys.size())
389      throw new IllegalArgumentException("_DisplayValues and Keys different length");
390    try (Model<K, D>.Remodel remodel = swingModel.getRemodel()) {
391      ///// autoGeneratedKeys = false;
392      List<K> keys = _keys;
393      if (keys == null) {
394        // Provide a [0,N) key
395        List<Object> autoKeys;
396        if (getKeyType() == Long.class)
397          autoKeys = LongStream.range(0, _displayValues.size())
398                         .collect(ArrayList::new, List::add, List::addAll);
399        else // defautl to Integer
400          autoKeys = IntStream.range(0, _displayValues.size())
401                         .collect(ArrayList::new, List::add, List::addAll);
402        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
403        List<K> xxx = (List<K>) autoKeys;
404        keys = xxx;
405        ///// autoGeneratedKeys = true;
406      }
407
408      List<D> displayValues = swingModel.getDisconnectedList(_displayValues);
409      keys = swingModel.getDisconnectedList(keys);
410
411      remodel.clear();
412      remodel.addAll(keys, displayValues);
413    }
414  }

430  private Class<K> keyType;
431
432  /**
433   * Return the actual type of the Key parameter.
434   * @return the type
435   */
436  final public Class<K> getKeyType() {
437    if (keyType == null) {
438      //@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
439      TypeToken<K> typeToken = new TypeToken<K>(getClass()) {};
440      @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
441      Class<K> t = (Class<K>) typeToken.getType();
442      keyType = t;
443    }
444    return keyType;
445  }

465  /**
466   * updates the corresponding column of the rowset with the values selected in
467   * the list
468   */
469  // TODO: quiet failure.
470  protected void updateRowSet() {
471    try {
472      dbCollection.writeData(this, getChosenKeys().toArray());
473    } catch (final SQLException se) {
474      logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> sf("%s: SQL Exception.", getColumnForLog()), se);
475    }
476  }

499  /**
500   * Updates the value stored and displayed in the SwingSet component based on
501   * getColumnText()
502   * <p>
503   * Call to this method should be coming from SSCommon and should already have
504   * the Component listener removed
505   */
506  public void updateComponent() {
507    if (swingModel == null) {
508      return;
509    }
510
511    Object array = null;
512    //
513    // TODO: Should getColumnObject() be used here?
514    //       Seems like it, it's used just about everywhere else.
515    //
516    try {
517      if (getRowsModel().onActiveRow())
518        array = dbCollection.readData(SsList1.this);
519    } catch (final SQLException se) {
520      logger.log(Level.ERROR, () -> sf("%s: SQL Exception.", getColumnForLog()), se);
521    }
522
523    if (array == null) {
524      logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s: Array is null. Clearing selection.", getColumnForLog()));
525      clearSelection();
526      return;
527    }
528
529    try {
530      Object[] objArray = convertArrayToObjectList(array).toArray();
531      setChosenKeys(objArray);
532      logger.log(DEBUG,
533                 () -> sf("%s: Updating component with array of %s.", getColumnForLog(),
534                          Arrays.toString(
535                               Arrays.copyOfRange(objArray, 0, Math.min(5, objArray.length)))));
536    } catch (IllegalArgumentException | SQLDataException ex) {
537      logger.log(Level.ERROR, ex.getMessage(), ex);
538    }
539  }

543  /** {@inheritDoc } */
544  @Override
545  public final Hook getSsComponentHook() {
546    if (hook == null)
547      hook = new Hook(this) {
548        @Override

550          updateComponent();
551        }
552
553        /** {@inheritDoc } */
554        @Override
555        protected ListListener getSsComponentListener() {
556          return new ListListener();
557        }
558
559        /** {@inheritDoc } */
560        @Override
561        protected void addSsComponentListener(EventListener eventListener) {
562          addListSelectionListener((ListSelectionListener) eventListener);
563        }
564
565        /** {@inheritDoc } */
566        @Override
567        protected void removeSsComponentListener(EventListener eventListener) {
568          removeListSelectionListener((ListSelectionListener) eventListener);
569        }
570      };
571    return hook;
572  }
